coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 5 ground-truth variable items: all four scheduling methods and broadly the fixed environment/data controls. The model configuration, microbatch settings, and throughput units do not match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses a roughly 7B model and sequence length 4096 instead of 1.5B and 2048, although several architectural dimensions match. Adds pipeline-depth variation rather than keeping the specified eight-GPU pipeline fixed. The microbatch grid omits 24 and adds multiple unrequested values. Reports tokens/sec/device and MFU instead of samples/sec/GPU. Fixed logging settings are not explicitly specified.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to provide the expected conclusion: throughput increases strongly with microbatch count for 1F1B, 1F1B-I, and ZB-1p, while ZB-2p remains consistently high and near the upper bound regardless of microbatch count.
